t: A fast ESP32 chip built for cameras, screens, video, and sound.
steps: Buy a board such as the SparkFun IoT RedBoard ESP32-P4, the Adafruit Metro ESP32-P4 or the Olimex ESP32-P4-DevKit.
Check which chip revision your board uses in its product notes.
Install Visual Studio Code and the free ESP-IDF extension.
Set the target to esp32p4 and match the chip revision setting.
Plug in a USB-C cable and flash the hello world example.
Connect a MIPI screen with the correct ribbon cable.
Run a display example from the esp-dev-kits examples.
Try a camera example once the screen works.
meta: Wild Open. From $34.95. A few stores.
